title: Transport Hints v1 (Working Draft 0.1)
description: Records that say how a file already published with a SHA-256 can also be fetched as a single-file hybrid BitTorrent v1+v2 torrent. They carry no authority: the SHA-256 in the authority record is the only identity of the bytes, and a torrent hash is never accepted in its place. The artifact-descriptor and descriptor-set documents are closed at every level. The hints-index is the only open document. See TRANSPORT-HINTS-0.1-DRAFT.md.
$comment: Working Draft. The profile single-file-hybrid/1 is not frozen, and no descriptor of a real file may be published under this draft. Validators MUST enable format assertion (Ajv 2020 with ajv-formats, as bin/build-love-packages.ts does). Within each closed object, the order of 'properties' below is the serialisation key order of the draft's section 5. Cross-field rules that JSON Schema cannot express are listed in the draft's sections 4.4, 6 and 8.3; schema validity alone is not conformance.

sha256Hex.description: Lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 digest, 64 characters, no prefix.

btih.description: BitTorrent v1 infohash: lowercase hexadecimal SHA-1 of the bencoded info dictionary, 40 characters.

btmh.description: BitTorrent v2 infohash as a multihash: '1220' (sha2-256, 32 bytes) followed by the lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 of the bencoded info dictionary.

byteSize.description: Exact byte length as a non-zero I-JSON-safe integer. Empty files are out of scope.

httpsUrl.description: Absolute HTTPS URL written in one spelling: lowercase DNS host name (no IP literal, no port, no userinfo), a path of printable ASCII with uppercase percent-escapes, no dot segments, no query and no fragment. Builders copy URLs exactly and never normalise them.

webSeedUrl.description: A web seed: the full URL of the one file. It never ends in '/', so a client never appends the torrent name to it.

bareFilename.description: A bare ASCII filename as the authority record names the file: alphanumerics, dot, underscore, plus and hyphen, starting with an alphanumeric. It is not content identity.

torrentName.description: The torrent 'name': a bare ASCII filename of 1 to 200 characters from A-Z, a-z, 0-9, '.', '_', '+' and '-', starting and ending with an alphanumeric, and not a reserved Windows device name. Unique across the estate and never reused for other bytes (not checkable by schema).

memberPath.description: A normalised POSIX path of a member inside the subject archive, for example package/LICENSE: no leading slash, no empty, '.' or '..' segment.

spdxLicenseId.description: One short identifier from the SPDX License List, for example CC0-1.0 or Apache-2.0. Not an expression, not NONE or NOASSERTION, not a LicenseRef. The schema checks the shape only; membership of the list is a consumer check.

pieceLength.description: A power of two from 16 KiB to 16 MiB. The profile further requires the one value its formula gives for subject.size (draft section 7.3).

dateTime.description: A UTC time in whole seconds, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ.

subject.description: The file, copied exactly from the authority record. subject.sha256 is the identity of the bytes.

authority.description: Where the record that already publishes subject.sha256 is, and how to read the digest from it.

authorityLovePackage.description: A LOVE package manifest. The consumer also requires /artifact/size, /artifact/filename and /license to equal the descriptor's values.

pointer.description: An RFC 6901 JSON Pointer to a string of 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

url.description: A commit-pinned /resolve/<40-hex commit>/<path> URL. A branch or tag name in place of the commit is refused.

authoritySumsLine.description: A checksums document in which exactly one line holds a digest and subject.filename.

authorityNonePrior.description: No earlier record of the digest exists; the descriptor is its first public statement. The hashing time is held in the index entry's none_prior.hashed_at, because the descriptor holds no date.

noticeFile.description: A licence or notice file published beside the subject, identified by its own size and SHA-256, at a commit-pinned or otherwise permanent URL.

inside_subject.description: Members of the subject archive that carry its licence and notices, sorted ascending by byte value.

beside_subject.description: Separate notice files, sorted ascending by filename, filenames unique.

notices.description: Licence and attribution notices that travel with the bytes. At least one is named. These are not the irreversibility notice of the clearance rule.

pieces_root.description: BEP 52 merkle root of the file over 16 KiB blocks. It equals subject.sha256 exactly when subject.size is at most 16384.

bittorrent.description: The torrent identifiers. Both infohashes depend only on the bytes, the name and the piece length. No web-seed list, .torrent URL, tracker or date belongs here.

home.description: The page or record where the publisher keeps the file and its licence.

license.description: Spelled as LOVE manifests spell the field. Required and never null: no licence, no descriptor.

recall.description: A published descriptor and the identifiers in it cannot be recalled.

artifactDescriptor.$comment: Closed at every level, every field required, so two honest builders given the same inputs emit the same bytes. It holds no date, no web-seed list, no .torrent URL and no field named signature; any such field fails validation.

set_id.description: A label for one round of listings. It is not a date field and implies no time.

descriptors.description: Sorted strictly ascending by subject_sha256; one entry per subject.

descriptorSet.$comment: Closed at every level and unsigned. A later, separate signature format may sign these exact bytes; until then nothing about a set may be called signed.

url_list.description: The exact url-list inside the .torrent file, in its order.

by.description: Who or what made the observation, for example a named probe job.

observation.description: One dated observation. Its other fields are open until a probe format is written.

replica.description: Another copy of the bytes that the estate knows of, with how (or whether) it can be recalled.

none_prior.description: Present exactly when the descriptor's authority.kind is none-prior: the time the bytes were hashed.

superseded_by.description: descriptor_sha256 of the entry that replaces this one.

previous_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact bytes of the previous version as served; null only for version 1.

hintsIndex.$comment: Open and mutable: unknown fields are allowed at the index, entry and observation levels so the probe and listing formats can grow, but no field may be named signature. Every change is a new version chained by previous_sha256. This part of the schema is a draft target, not a frozen format.
